opening.argument: The speaker promotes BitConnect as a loan opportunity built on an upfront Bitcoin deposit, conversion into tokens, and an expected capital release with interest. The required path is explicit: “all you have to do is deposit bitcoin onto the website convert over to tokens on the BCC Exchange on the left and your pretty much ready to do your loan.” He presents unusually high returns and supports the pitch with his payout and account statements, while soliciting sign-ups through a team link. The incentive is also recruitment-based: “Basically you earn 7% of whatever that person deposits onto you.” The records do not establish whether those returns were delivered or whether viewers lost money.
